ease.reason: A beginner can test a cost-options memo with fictional inputs, but the request gives no account setup or cost fields.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: bootstrapped startups needing affordable AWS scaling may pay for advisory help; the request proves neither buying intent nor payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can turn operator supplied sample costs and workload goals into options; AWS specifics and accuracy remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed tool could organize inputs and draft options, but no source supports automated analysis and an operator must validate every change.

evidence.reason: The fresh request explicitly seeks affordable AWS scaling help, but gives no repeated steps, inputs, or corroboration for this proposed memo.

candidates.reason: Concrete request assessed as a narrow hypothetical cost-options memo using operator supplied test inputs; provisional mean is below the 6 threshold and implementation support is absent.
